Amendment No. 3 sets 230 seats from 2027-01-01 but gives no price. The $2,356 probably comes from Dana's email or CRM note, so it's worth checking with her before Hollis relies on it.

I drafted the mail without confirming the wording with you first. It's short and marked as a draft for review. I can change or delete it if you want.
